summary: A Big-Tech-grade engineering operating system built on Claude Code, dogfooded on its own repo.
note: CodeMaster bootstrapped itself before the blueprint skills existed, so its upstream design modules were never produced as structured JSON. This blueprint is a navigational index: it maps CodeMaster's real design-of-record (docs/, ROADMAP.md, backlog/tickets/) onto the greenfield 6-step model. The backlog stays in markdown by the two-serializations decision (ROADMAP decisions log, 2026-06-05). The conformance gate (scripts/validate-blueprint.js) scans examples/ only, so this index carries no schema-backed JSON to validate.

design-thinking.note: CodeMaster's what & why predate the design-thinking skill; never captured as 20 structured steps.

system-design.note: The doctrine in docs/ IS CodeMaster's system design — capabilities, robust-code loop, delivery, profiles, orchestration.

specs.note: /spec runs at ticket altitude; outputs ride on individual tickets as plan.md, not a central specs/.

backlog.note: Kept as markdown (folder-per-ticket) by the two-serializations decision — not mirrored to JSON here.
